page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB per core, and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is provisioned at a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate moderate single-core performance alongside constrained multi-core and memory capabilities. The instance achieves average ratings in single-core stress-ng and Geekbench tests, as well as single-threaded gzip and bzip3 operations. However, multi-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench falls into the bottom 10 percent, reflecting the physical single-core limitation. Memory bandwidth is also low, with uncached read and write speeds of 13.97 GB/sec and 12.92 GB/sec respectively. Passmark CPU and memory scores are weak to poor, and database operations or Redis SET operations are similarly limited.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7t.large offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio within a low-resource footprint, making it a viable option for memory-bound workloads that do not require intensive parallel processing. Due to its dedicated CPU allocation and moderate single-thread performance, it is suited for lightweight database caching, basic web serving, text processing, and small-scale memory-intensive applications. It is less suitable for multi-threaded compilation, heavy data science, or high-throughput database operations.
